title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked November 22, 2026 at 20:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 318 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

Things are pretty quiet. 🖤

A broad dark coronal region and several bright active areas are visible today, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph view.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
